title: [2.8.2.2 Dev] Sometimes manual bolus are not correctly recorded in database
body:
After several month of tests, I found about one week ago a very strange bug with manual bolus (done with "Insulin Button" on main screen). I saw this bug 3 times, 2 times last week, and last time this morning at 9h59.
(Hopefully the great majority of boluses are correctly recorded)

This morning at 9:59, I made a manual bolus with Insulin button, this bolus was correctly delivered (I saw the Pop Up with the bar graph), but later when I wanted to make another bolus, I saw that previous bolus made at 9h59 was missing in IOB graph and in Treatment tab, I could only see it in User Entry and in the history of my Pump ???
- I tried to analyse Log, but and don't see anything that could explain why this bolus is missing in treatments and IOB calculation
- In NS/Synchronization, I have only "Upload data to NS" enabled, all other settings are disabled
- Pump Accu-Check Insight

![BugManualBolus](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/130680605-6697a7a0-5b18-42f0-a906-303efec61c3a.jpg)

I attached an Excel file with concatenation of log files and extract of each on of the 3 boluses made this morning:
- First tab with complete log (I only removed D/GLUCOSE and D/AUTOMATION to limit the number of lines)
- Second Tab Bolus 10.51U made at 08:04 with QuickWizard, (everything is OK)
- Third Tab Bolus 4U made at 09:59 with Insulin Button, correctly delivered in pump but not shown in Treatments, IOB calculation and IOB graph
- Fourth Tab Bolus 4U made at 11:15 with Insulin Button (everything is OK)

[LogBolusKO.xlsx](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7041758/LogBolusKO.xlsx)

comments.body: It happened to me 2 times too! I had lunch and I used the insulin and carbohydrate button, the bolus was correctly delivered and the carbohydrates were correctly registered but the insulin was not! In fact aaps had started doing 1U boluses via SMB and I noticed it. To solve the problem I then did a no delivery bolus to block SMB.

Thank's
I don't know if it's in the driver or not but I also have an Insight pump...
I propose to add logs and database verification in driver to help me...

And Insight driver should not report `Result success: true` in this case

Concerning the bolus of 8U, it started before the cartridge replacement, (less than 8U remaing in reservoir) and finished after pump resume.
The 8U are correctly administered in my pump history.. 
I'll continue analysis hope I still have later log

I got 5 missing SMB between midnight and 1:00, then after a stop and restart of AAPS, next SMB was correctly recorded.
![Screenshot_20210925-010951_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/134748441-febf7ec7-a78f-4d1a-8b0d-2b86813f0588.jpg)

It seems that sometimes Database is not updated correctly after pumpSync.syncBolusWithPumpId.
(I added an alert each time the lastrecorded bolus is not the same than the one updated by syncBolusWithPumpId immediatly, this alert should never occurs, but I got it several times, and each time a SMB delivered by the pump was not recorded in database)

I recently added new debugs to get more informations and continue analysis, but everything seems to be ok in Insight plugin (I suspect an issue difficult to catch because rare, in pumpsync implementation or in database).

Until now I only got this alert on my loop phone (never on my dev phone running in parallel), and I can have several days without any missing records, and 2 or 3 following days with one to 3 missing SMB (no more)...

I think I got it with my latest debug:
```
00:02:38.121 [Thread-28694] D/PUMP: [LocalInsightPlugin.deliverTreatment():610]: XXXX deliverTreatment 9685 Update database sent: 01/10/2021 00:02 amount: 0.11 Result: true

00:02:39.887 [Thread-28694] D/PUMP: [LocalInsightPlugin.processBolusDeliveredEvent():1466]: XXXX Last bolus delivered 9685 Update database sent: 30/09/2021 00:02 amount: 0.11 Result: false
00:02:39.951 [Thread-28694] E/PUMP: [LocalInsightPlugin.processBolusDeliveredEvent():1468]: XXXX Last bolus in Database after update 30/09/2021 22:57 amount: 0.12
00:02:40.019 [Thread-28694] E/PUMP: [LocalInsightPlugin.processBolusDeliveredEvent():1470]: XXXX Last bolus delevered 9685 not recorded in database
00:02:40.031 [Thread-28694] D/PUMP: [LocalInsightPlugin.processBolusProgrammedEvent():1381]: XXXX Bolus Programmed 9685/329905/329906 already recorded in Insight database
```
SMB correctly recorded in deliverTreatment
ID is found in readHistory during the process of processBolusDeliveredEvent from pump, but the calculated date from pump event is shifted one day before compared to real timestamp (strange because this calculation was not modified during update of the plugin for new database)

=> I'll fix this bug very quickly.
